narrative.overview:
The user-approved editorial world uses cream paper, charcoal ink, upright Cantata One headings and Manrope controls. Red outlined Start / Next, red filled Reset and saturated teal Float support a smaller host clock and editable agenda. Thin rules and flat surfaces replace the earlier mineral/acid world. Floating and audience screens remain dark.

The final source of visual overrides is docs/editorial.css after base.css and workspace.css. The reference image is directional: subsequent explicit user corrections supersede its oversized clock, pale green, filled Start and connector geometry. The historical failed 63.7 reproduction remains historical evidence, not a current passed gate or an exact-match claim. Current review artifacts are .impeccable/review/desktop.png, mobile.png, user-320.png and mobile-agenda.png. This documentation does not assert deployment status. Preserve https://cytramonp.github.io/relay-timer/ and PRODUCT.md behavior; CorpTimer is the selected working brand with domain registration pending.

Approved block refinement: docs/blocks.css loads last. The light page contains a dark teal timer and outlined light working panels with 14px corners and no shadows. Start / Next is cream, Float bright teal, Reset salmon. Templates and Add actions have clear outlines. The thin extended bent grey/red agenda trace has no endpoint circles and hides at 1100px. The decorative stopwatch is hidden. Audience mode matches the light page and dark timer. Preserve selected logo A and the canonical URL. This refinement supersedes earlier borderless panels, outlined Start and short dotted connector descriptions.
keyCharacteristics: Cream and charcoal editorial host workspace
Self-hosted upright Cantata One and Manrope
Compact host clock with paused opacity .72
Cream transport, salmon Reset and bright teal Float in a dark timer
Thin extended bent grey-red trace to the whole agenda, without endpoint circles
Responsive focused task navigation at 320px and 390px
Dark floating content; light audience page with dark timer; private host tools kept separate

rules.name: Action roles
rules.body: Preserve cream transport, salmon Reset and bright teal Float within the dark timer block.

rules.name: Editorial hierarchy
rules.body: Upright Cantata One headings and Manrope host clock and controls; retain tabular figures.

rules.name: Flat workspace
rules.body: Use rules, spacing and paper tones instead of ambient card shadows.

dos: Do preserve the actual editable agenda, host authority and timing behavior.
Do keep the thin bent trace without endpoint circles at agenda-heading level and hide it at 1100px and below.
Do retain mobile task navigation, 16px mobile fields and visible keyboard focus.
Do keep the canonical URL, optional Google sign-in and immediate app entry.
donts: Don't restore the superseded mineral/acid palette.
Don't treat the historical reproduction score as current approval or claim exact comp matching.
Don't enlarge the clock or restore the decorative stopwatch.
Don't connect to individual speaker rows or expose private notes and reports to audience views.
Don't introduce external font dependencies or claim PiP is visible in every sharing mode.
